notes: engizousan heads on 'nigh' (rules 71, 91) while 10.1's proserchomenous heads on 'draw', its lexeme resting on erchomai.
tosouto heads on 'much' as a degree correlative (rule 104); the supplied reciprocal object stays with the verb that requires it in English (rule 74's contrast).
